constantes.texto: average bulk density of lunar regolith at the surface (1.30 g/cm3)
constantes.cita: the bulk density of lunar regolith is approximately 1.30 g/cm3 at the surface, and increases asymptotically to 1.92 g/cm3 below a depth of 100 cm.
